confidence_notes: I estimated the food and drink anchors from aggregated cost-of-living sites (mylifeelsewhere, nomad.watch and a currency-shop guide that uses Numbeo data from mid-2025). Those sources disagree: a cappuccino is listed at $2.69 to $4.12, an inexpensive meal at about $7.50 and a beer at $2.18 to $3.17. Prices for tourists in Ocho Rios are usually higher than local averages, so I moved the anchors toward the upper end of these ranges. I did not find aggregated figures for cocktails or wine. I estimated both from typical Jamaican price ratios to beer and from wine being imported, so these two are less certain. The accommodation anchors are model estimates from general knowledge only and are the least certain. Ocho Rios has few registered hostels, so the dorm and private-room figures are bounded guesses. I did not check any booking pages.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other Jamaican resort towns such as Montego Bay and Negril, and to Caribbean cruise-port towns with a mix of local and tourist pricing.
